design.policy: One greedy native I3 attempt per prefix, no header; intact global next-document note donors.
design.reward: All16 original continuation tokens; no arithmetic mask or scalar teacher.
design.interface: I3 reanchor24, fixedI6=.375 secondary, full-vocabulary logits.

costs.scope: Observed action/content and note latency include all saved attempts, including errors/partials. Score cell times count shared I3/I6 work once and include actual raw forward/softmax/transfer costs. Model setup/native gate/process-stage times are separate; no warm or end-to-end throughput claim.

interpretation: Own notes hurt raw and empty likelihood and score below intact unrelated notes on both paths. Copying supplied future16 strongly helps, preserving reader headroom without establishing useful prefix-only generation.
decision: B0 fails useful-content gate on both paths. Continue declared supervised reader/writer warm-start and separate prospective prefix-helper prompt probe; no RL release.

independent.method: Separate native context reconstruction, full16-vector sums and vectorized paired document bootstrap; no experiment reducer called.

examples_selection: First6 fixed panel documents, all controls; no gain-based selection.

limitations: B0-surprisal-conditioned developmental DEV, not unselected GENERAL or official TEST.
Cap128 TOTAL actions includes sampled native first-close/EOS; capped content is never truncated.
Other is an intact global cyclic own-note permutation; per-item lengths differ, population lengths are preserved.
target_copy is exact native future16; corrupt_copy is next-document future16, not a certified mathematically false note.
Target-copy headroom is plumbing, not useful prefix-only writer evidence. No arithmetic teacher or numeric mask.
Fixed I6=.375 uses full logits; no fit or policy-training change. Shared score costs count once per timing group.
Document bootstrap is conditional on B0 and the selected development panel, not training-seed uncertainty.
Latency totals sum actual concurrent-worker paths and include cold work; not an end-to-end or steady-throughput benchmark.
